zh.explain: 君子不要做出小人的行为，如果处事出了差错也会惹来是非。琴要弹给懂音乐的人听，如果自己能静心安守，也许会等来贵人的帮助。
divination: 一切事情，只有在面对知音时才可以应允。至于闲事，更是不要去理睬。
待到时机成熟，得到贵人相助，自然一切都会欢喜。
items: 不利。宜和合共识做决定。
zh.summary: 此卦要逢知己之象。所祈求之事宜怀着耐心而坚守常态，则会吉祥。

verse: The virtuous think not like the villains,
Whose conduct shows their faults and differences.
Only the tutored will appreciate the fine music,
Remain and quietly wait for the rare company.
interpretation: Stay away from gossips and wait for a mutual friend who knows and understands you and brings joy to you.
meaning: One will meet a genuine and mutual friend.
Maintain things as-is and everything will turn out right.
en.explain: A gentleman should not behave like a villain. If things go wrong, it might also invite trouble. Play the qin only to people who appreciate music. Keep a quiet vigil and perhaps benefactors may come to your aid.
divination: If it’s a bosom friend, you can agree to their requests on all matters, and ignore other idle matters. When the right time comes & you can get a benefactor’s help, naturally everything will be joyous.
items: Don't act rashly, keep the status quo
Be law-abiding, wait for the opportunity
Need a good Doctor otherwise will have obstacles

notes: zh item 出门在外 uses a full-width semicolon (出门在外；还在途中) instead of a colon in the image; key/value split anyway. EN Divination lacks the usual opening 'This is an inauspicious lot.' line (zh has 此签为下签。). EN mixes straight and curly apostrophes as printed.
